src.t: Radek Ratusznik (One More Level), interview, Inverse, Oct 2020

links.took: John Cooper's Wild West outlaw squad, vision-cone stealth puzzles and synchronized Quick Action plans.
links.added: Modernized real-time tactics with Mimimi's Showdown pause-queue mode, fluid gamepad controls and five specialists.

src.t: PC Gamer, Mimimi Games on Desperados III, 2018
Game Developer, Designing the Real-Time Stealth of Desperados III, 2020

links.extra: Built by Mimimi Games on the stealth-strategy toolkit they refined in Shadow Tactics: Blades of the Shogun.

links.took: Jill Valentine's desperate Raccoon City escape while stalked relentlessly by the bioweapon Nemesis.
links.added: Rebuilt the 1999 classic in RE Engine with over-the-shoulder aiming, a perfect-dodge counter and cinematic pacing.

links.took: Capcom's RE Engine over-the-shoulder survival horror controls, lighting and modern Raccoon City assets.
links.added: Leaned harder into action set pieces, Carlos Oliveira combat segments and agile dodge-roll timing.
links.extra: Co-developed by Capcom and M-Two concurrently with Resident Evil 2 (2019).

links.took: Tommy Angelo's 1930s Lost Heaven mobster rise, period cars and grounded Prohibition crime drama.
links.added: Rebuilt the 2002 classic from the ground up with modern cover shooting, motorcycles and expanded character scenes.
links.extra: Developed by Hangar 13 on an upgraded Mafia III engine.

links.took: Two-minute arcade skatepark runs, score goals and classic Warehouse-to-Venice levels.
links.added: Rebuilt both games in crisp HD while folding in later revert, spine-transfer and wall-plant combo tools.
links.extra: Developed by Vicarious Visions, returning to the franchise after its acclaimed GBA ports.

links.took: Manuals linking aerial tricks across parks, custom park builders and career stat points.
links.added: Added modern pro skaters, online multiplayer playlists and unified challenges across both campaigns.

links.took: Precision time-trial stunt tracks, instant resets, no-collision ghost racing and a built-in block editor.
links.added: Reinvented the series as a live-service seasonal platform with daily Tracks of the Day and Cup competitions.
links.extra: Ubisoft Nadeo's reboot of its Trackmania Nations competitive standard.

links.took: Intuitive motion-swung golf accessible to non-gamers in friendly living-room multiplayer.
links.added: Moved casual putting into social VR across fantastical themed courses, lost-ball hunts and natural voice hangouts.
links.extra: Created during 2020 lockdowns by filmmaker Lucas Martell using an earlier mobile AR engine.

links.took: Robert Kirkman's zombie apocalypse world and harsh moral choices between desperate human factions.
links.added: Pioneered weighty physics-based VR melee combat, physical backpack scavenging and crafting in flooded New Orleans.

src.t: Wikipedia: The Walking Dead: Saints & Sinners

links.extra: Released by Skydance Interactive in January 2020, two months before Half-Life: Alyx.

links.took: First-person zombie scavenging loops balancing weapon durability, stamina drain and escalating danger timers.
links.added: Translated melee survival tension to full VR hand physics where blades stick inside zombie skulls.

src.t: Wikipedia: The Walking Dead: Saints & Sinners

links.took: Melancholic ruined-kingdom atmosphere, interconnected 2D Metroidvania exploration and demanding boss encounters.
links.added: Made protagonist Lily defenseless, fighting purely through purified boss spirits with customizable cooldown loadouts.

src.t: Hiroyuki Kobayashi (Binary Haze Interactive), quoted by mxdwn, 2024
Wikipedia: Ender Lilies: Quietus of the Knights

links.extra: Co-developed by Adglobe and Live Wire with music by Mili.

links.took: Absorbing defeated enemies' souls to equip varied spectral attacks and traversal skills.
links.added: Built the entire combat moveset around mixing three active spirit summons per weapon set.

src.t: Wikipedia: Ender Lilies: Quietus of the Knights

links.took: Yoko Taro's tragic multi-ending story, bullet-hell magic combat and Keiichi Okabe's vocal soundtrack.
links.added: Brought Japan's brother-protagonist Replicant version worldwide with revamped combat, full voice acting and a new ending.
links.extra: Developed by Toylogic with combat supervision from PlatinumGames' Takahisa Taura.

links.took: Smooth combo chaining, agile dodging and responsive action-RPG combat feel from Automata's designers.
links.added: Retrofitted Automata-style fluidity onto the 2010 original while preserving its smaller village-and-quest rhythm.

links.took: Sackboy's stitched Craftworld materials, charming knit costumes and playful four-player family co-op.
links.added: Dropped user-generated level tools and floaty 2.5D physics for tight, 60fps curated 3D platforming.
links.extra: Sumo Digital previously developed LittleBigPlanet 3 before launching Sackboy on PS5.

links.took: Fixed-angle isometric 3D obstacle courses built around simultaneous four-player couch platforming.
links.added: Paired tactile fabric-and-cardboard worlds with rhythmic licensed music levels and slap-and-roll co-op hijinks.

links.took: Paper-craft humor, flat storybook Mario characters and expressive self-aware adventure writing.
links.added: Introduced seamless open-zone exploration, stretchy 1,000-Fold Arms and concentric ring-sliding battle puzzles.

src.t: Wikipedia: Paper Mario: The Origami King

links.took: Omega Force's Zelda-themed Musou crowd battles, playable champions and weak-point gauge breaks.
links.added: Set the action 100 years before Breath of the Wild with Sheikah Slate runes and Divine Beast missions.

src.t: Wikipedia: Hyrule Warriors: Age of Calamity

links.took: Breath of the Wild's cel-shaded Hyrule art, Four Champions, Sheikah runes and flurry-rush timing.
links.added: Reframed the Calamity backstory as large-scale Musou battlefield skirmishes before Hyrule fell.

src.t: Wikipedia: Hyrule Warriors: Age of Calamity

links.extra: Developed by Omega Force in close narrative collaboration with Nintendo's Zelda team.

links.took: The Phantom Thieves' stylish UI, Persona fusion, baton passes and direct story continuation.
links.added: Replaced turn-based dungeon battles with a real-time summer road trip across Japan in Musou style.
links.extra: Co-developed by Omega Force and Atlus's P-Studio.

links.took: Omega Force's combo-driven crowd-clearing action combat against huge waves of enemies.
links.added: Blended real-time hack-and-slash hordes with pause-to-cast Persona spells and elemental weakness strikes.

links.took: Five-on-five three-lane Summoner's Rift strategy, champion kits and teamfight objective control.
links.added: Rebuilt the game from scratch for touchscreens with twin-stick controls, smaller maps and 15-minute matches.

src.t: Wikipedia: League of Legends: Wild Rift

links.took: Twin-stick mobile MOBA layout, streamlined item shopping and crisp 15-minute phone match pacing.
links.added: Brought Riot's official League champions, skillshot targeting and PC mechanical depth to mobile.

src.t: Wikipedia: League of Legends: Wild Rift

links.extra: Followed Tencent's massive mobile MOBA breakthrough in China.

links.took: Open-world drone hacking, ctOS security puzzles and playful DedSec activist tech gadgets.
links.added: Dropped a single hero so any simulated London pedestrian can be recruited into the resistance.
links.extra: Directed by Clint Hocking at Ubisoft Toronto.

links.took: Isometric action-RPG progression, loot stats, skill upgrades and cooperative monster-clearing momentum.
links.added: Swapped dark fantasy dungeons for twin-stick cyberpunk gunfights, height-aiming cover and dense Blade Runner alleys.

src.t: Arcade Berg & Tor Frick (Neon Giant), Unreal Engine interview, 2021

links.extra: Built by a twelve-person Swedish studio of former Wolfenstein, Doom and Bulletstorm veterans.

links.took: Isometric megacorporation-run cyberpunk streets, cybernetic upgrades and heavy sci-fi firepower.
links.added: Focused on direct twin-stick solo and co-op shooting inside a towering vertical arcology.

links.took: Episodic first-person mascot horror set inside a decaying entertainment company's abandoned workplace.
links.added: Swapped 1930s cartoons for a sinister toy factory, VHS lore tapes and relentless chases by Huggy Wuggy.

links.took: First-person environmental traversal puzzles inside an eerie abandoned corporate research complex.
links.added: Replaced the portal gun with the dual-handed GrabPack for conducting circuits and swinging past toy monsters.

links.took: Task-based map movement, emergency body-report meetings and voting out hidden killers among friends.
links.added: Added built-in proximity voice chat, neutral wildcard factions and dozens of distinct goose and duck roles.
links.extra: Surged past 700,000 concurrent Steam players in early 2023.

links.took: Role-heavy social deduction where neutral jesters, executioners and special investigators complicate voting.
links.added: Brought multi-role social deception into real-time 2D movement maps with proximity voice chat.

links.took: Upgradeable castle hub, worker-capped construction timers and resource-producing village layouts on mobile.
links.added: Paired cozy customizable cookie kingdom building with gacha squad-RPG story campaigns and arena battles.
links.extra: Expanded Devsisters' Cookie Run endless-runner IP into a hybrid RPG city builder.

links.took: IO Interactive's Glacier engine, social stealth sandboxes and modular level-design pipeline.
links.added: Applied systemic spy tradecraft to a young James Bond origin story with gadgets, chases and cinematic action.

src.t: Radio Times, IO Interactive on 007 First Light, 2025

links.extra: Originally announced as Project 007; uses IOI's Hitman: World of Assassination production architecture.

links.took: Interactive James Bond espionage fantasy balancing spy gadgets, infiltration objectives and cinematic gunfights.
links.added: Shifted from 1990s N64 corridor FPS missions to a third-person systemic spy-action origin adventure.

links.took: Sixty-player drop-in scavenging on a shrinking island until one survivor or trio remains.
links.added: Replaced firearms with wuxia martial arts duels, rock-paper-scissors parries and omnidirectional grappling hooks.

src.t: Rock Paper Shotgun, Naraka: Bladepoint preview, 2021

links.extra: Lead producer Ray Kuan previously worked on 2002 wuxia classic Meteor Butterfly Sword.

links.took: Vertical grappling-hook traversal, blade-clashing deflects and high-stakes melee counter timing.
links.added: Adapted tense samurai-style sword clashes and vertical mobility into a competitive 60-player battle royale.

src.t: Rock Paper Shotgun, Naraka: Bladepoint preview, 2021

links.took: Observing quirky creature behaviors and using specialized nets, tripwires and gadgets to capture them.
links.added: Built a first-person story mystery about half-bug, half-snack critters that transform villagers who eat them.
links.extra: Young Horses co-founders also cited Pokemon Snap alongside Ape Escape for its creature-catching puzzles.

links.took: Studying creature routines and luring critters with sauces and bait to trigger interactions.
links.added: Added free-roaming island exploration, trap-chaining puzzles and character interviews across Snaktooth Island.

links.took: Chaotic top-down four-player couch co-op built around timed household tasks and frantic shouting.
links.added: Swapped kitchen assembly lines for slapstick physics furniture hauling, window-tossing and flexible assist modes.
links.extra: Co-developed by SMG Studio and DevM Games and published by Overcooked publisher Team17.

links.took: Combining matching tiles on a tight mobile grid to create progressively higher-tier pieces.
links.added: Pioneered the free-drag Merge-2 mobile hit loop tied to mansion renovation and soap-opera mystery ads.
links.extra: Metacore's 2020 breakout sparked a major wave of narrative Merge-2 puzzle games.

links.took: Surviving until 6 AM against lethal Fazbear animatronics using camera feeds and limited battery power.
links.added: Expanded the single security office into a free-roaming 3D Mega Pizzaplex mall with an allied Freddy.

src.t: Wikipedia: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach

links.extra: Developed by Steel Wool Studios following VR entry Help Wanted.

links.took: Five-second rapid-fire microgames ramping relentlessly in speed with eccentric Nintendo humor.
links.added: Put playable WarioWare crew members directly inside every microgame with distinct movement rules and two-player co-op.

links.took: Clean first-person parkour readability and shaving seconds off momentum-driven speedrun courses.
links.added: Turned collectible weapons into discardable movement cards for mid-air jumps, dashes and rocket boosts.
links.extra: Esposito also cited Quake and Super Monkey Ball for its bite-sized speedrun level structure.

links.took: Short, endlessly replayable arcade courses designed around discovering risky shortcut lines.
links.added: Built a card-driven first-person speedrunner wrapped in early-2000s anime visual-novel banter.

links.took: Cel-shaded Tokyo street style, inline-skate rail grinding, graffiti tagging and Hideki Naganuma beats.
links.added: Added trick-combo multipliers, skateboards, BMX bikes and a boost pack across interconnected Neo-Amsterdam boroughs.

src.t: Dion Koster & Tim Remmers (Team Reptile), GamesIndustry.biz, 2023
Kotaku, Bomb Rush Cyberfunk spiritual successor feature, 2022

links.extra: Reunited original Jet Set Radio composer Hideki Naganuma with Dutch indie studio Team Reptile.

links.took: Captain Titus's aggressive chainsword-and-bolter brawling and health-restoring execution loops.
links.added: Powered massive Tyranid swarms on Saber's Swarm Engine with three-player co-op Operations and parry gun-strikes.
links.extra: Developed by Saber Interactive thirteen years after Relic's 2011 original.

links.took: Rhythm-based blade deflection, posture-breaking parries and punishing skill-check boss duels.
links.added: Translated deflection combat to hand-drawn 2D Taopunk battles powered by qi-charged exploding talismans.

src.t: Red Candle Games, Nine Sols official campaign page, 2022
Vincent Yang (Red Candle Games), interview, PCGamesN, 2024

links.extra: Taiwanese horror studio Red Candle explicitly pitched Nine Sols as Sekiro-inspired 2D action.

links.took: Crisp hand-drawn 2D Metroidvania exploration, interconnected sci-fi fantasy biomes and tight platforming.
links.added: Layered deep character-driven Taoist cyberpunk storytelling over deflection-first melee combat.

src.t: Red Candle Games, Nine Sols official campaign page, 2022

links.took: Intimate first-person melee brawling, stealth traversal and grounded cinematic immersion.
links.added: Applied Starbreeze-lineage first-person craft to whip-swinging, disguises, tomb puzzles and globe-trotting adventure.

src.t: Jens Andersson & Jerk Gustafsson (MachineGames), PC Gamer, 2024
Wikipedia: Indiana Jones and the Great Circle

links.extra: Design director Jens Andersson and MachineGames founders previously led Escape from Butcher Bay.

links.took: MachineGames' id Tech engine, sharp Nazi-era character writing and punchy first-person animation.
links.added: De-emphasized gunplay in favor of improvised frying-pan brawls, stealth disguises and archaeological puzzles.

src.t: Wikipedia: Indiana Jones and the Great Circle
